statistical_hypothesis_correction.primary_metric: Paired Downside Shortfall Reduction on Defensive Sessions
statistical_hypothesis_correction.defensive_conditioning_filter: I_{def,t} = 1 \iff R_{m,t} < 0 \quad (\text{where } R_{m,t} \text{ is benchmark SPY/QQQ daily return})

hypothesis_1_directional_improvement.scientific_meaning: Tests whether D2 provides strictly non-negative downside shortfall reduction compared to E0. Passing H11 rules out that D2 worsens downside losses, but does NOT prove economic utility.
hypothesis_1_directional_improvement.decision_role: Necessary minimum filter, but INSUFFICIENT for strategy promotion.

hypothesis_2_economic_superiority.scientific_meaning: Tests whether D2's downside shortfall reduction exceeds the minimum economically meaningful threshold of 10 basis points per defensive day, ensuring alpha is not consumed by slippage, commissions, or bid-ask friction.
hypothesis_2_economic_superiority.decision_role: MANDATORY hurdle for prospective validation and strategy certification.

two_tier_hypothesis_framework.distinction_enforcement: Rejecting H01 does NOT imply rejecting H02. An observed mean \bar{d} = 3\text{ bps} may achieve p < 0.01 under large N, rejecting H01, yet fail H02 (p > 0.50). Conflating these two tests is a statistical fallacy.

newey_west_hac.sample_size_example: For N_def = 30, q = 3 lags; for N_def = 60, q = 3 lags; for N_def = 100, q = 4 lags

owner_decision_gate.note: Mathematical specification is finalized, but neither the 10-bps threshold nor the Newey-West lag formula has been formally approved by the owner.
